---
description: checks_odds as the model is told it - what the tool does, and what each of its arguments is.
arguments:
  action: "The action, by its id."
  actor: "Who would take it: their id, or their name as the world has it; leave it out for the player's character."
  params: "The action's arguments, as name: value; a person, thing or place by id or by name."
---
Reads the odds of an action as things stand now, by anyone: whether it can be tried now and, if not, the engine's reason; the chance of each outcome in percent; the dice, the modifier, the DC, advantage and whom it is rolled against; and what the world's way of judging checks makes of it. Nothing is rolled and nothing changes.
